newsitem.title: USA: NYH jet fuel diffs steady, potential USG weakness.
newsitem.headline: NYH jet fuel diffs steady, potential USG weakness.

text.p: New York Harbor prompt jet fuel differentials were steady Thursday as evenly balanced supplies put prices in a holding pattern.
"Supplies are in an equilibrium without much happening right now," said a dealer.

New York Harbor dealers noted that jet fuel supplies could eventually lean toward a surplus given the ample distillate supply in the region generally. Still, airline quality 54 grade remained bid at 2.75 cents over NYMEX heating oil and offered at three cents over.
NYMEX August heating oil, the prompt month, settled up 0.11 cent at 53.89 cents a gallon.

U.S. Gulf 54 grade was done at 0.45 and 0.40 cent over. Market talk that a deal was done later in the day at a much weaker 0.15 cent over could not be confirmed, and dealers who had heard of the deal could not explain the reason behind the much cheaper price.

Meanwhile, 55 grade in the Harbor was bid at three cents over, unchanged with Wednesday. In the U.S. Gulf, 55 grade was bid at 0.25 cent and offered at 0.50 cent over, reflecting the same bid/offer spread given 54 grade there.
